definition: For exact contextual constraints F_r(C,h)=0, substitute the completion-neighbor Boolean forms and define A(s,h)={b in {0,1}: all reduced exact Boolean constraints hold}.

examples.inconsistent: b=0 and b=1 simultaneously gives empty A
examples.symmetric_constraint: b*(1-b)=0 gives A={0,1} on Boolean B and does not initialize

theorem: A unique initial BRC branch is established iff the full declared contextual exact solution set is a singleton. No post-result tiebreak is permitted.
